purpose: Demonstrate that an administrative zonal mean alone can be identical while raster-footprint and finite-data support differ materially.
claim_boundary: This experiment demonstrates the information value of SuRT-GeoHarmonizer's mandatory three-part support contract. It does not claim that underlying geospatial libraries are incapable of calculating comparable diagnostics when explicitly programmed.

local_verification.notes: All four collision cases returned value 10 while the mandatory support fields distinguished complete support, finite-data loss, raster-footprint loss, and combined loss.
